Figure 3. Overview of SS-TPT. From a test image, multiple views are generated through augmentations A. Each view is evaluated by two quality scores: (i) stability, measuring invariance under weak augmentationsA′, and (ii) suitability, assessing feature-space density among views. These scores produce SS weights that guide both adaptation and inference: (1) an SS-guided consistency loss aligns predictions toward more trustworthy views, and (2) an SS-weighted prediction aggregates predictions while suppressing corrupted views.
